narrative: Demand for PL1__M2E41291 is erratic (CV=0.55) with a mean of 383 units/day and 96.6% non-zero days, indicating a regularly active but highly variable material. Lead times average 4.08 days with moderate variability (CV=0.36), producing a combined sigma_LTD of 709 units. The (r,Q) policy was selected as the demand is continuous with identifiable reorder signals; EOQ was capped by the 4,029-unit storage limit, and a safety stock of 1,167 units was set to achieve the 95% service level. Total annual costs fall by 28.4% versus the current zero-safety-stock SAP configuration.
warnings: High capacity utilization (>95%): SS+OQ=4029 units vs max_storage=4029.546 units

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is quasi-continuous (96.6% non-zero days) with no significant trend, making a fixed-reorder-point, fixed-quantity policy appropriate. EOQ provides the cost-minimizing order quantity, bounded by the MOQ (1,483) and the hard storage cap (4,029.5 units).
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity is nearly fully utilized at 99.99%. Any increase in safety stock due to lead time deterioration or higher service levels cannot be accommodated without a storage capacity increase. Order frequency (33/year) is higher than the EOQ optimum due to the capacity cap, moderately increasing ordering costs.
